name: System, small (React + FastAPI + PostgreSQL)
summary: A complete full-stack system on one origin: the React 19 web-app starter and the FastAPI starter behind a Traefik gateway, PostgreSQL 18 for data, and a backend-for-frontend sign-in (oauth2-proxy with sessions in Valkey, Keycloak as the identity provider) so the browser never holds a token. One compose project (docker compose up --wait), one worked feature (items), a Playwright suite that signs in through the real identity provider and drives the real API and database. Sized for one team and one database; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says what to add to grow it.
features: Single origin through Traefik (file config, no Docker socket): /api to FastAPI, everything else to the SPA, /idp to Keycloak
BFF sign-in: HttpOnly session cookie, tokens stay server-side, CSRF header enforced at the gateway
Hardened containers: non-root, read-only filesystems, no capabilities, digest-pinned images, secrets only from a gitignored .env

toolchain.installHint: Install Docker (Desktop or Engine with the compose plugin): https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/. Node 24 is needed only to run the scripts and the web checks outside containers.
